name: Two-token basket
description: Builds a small, even position in two tokens, $B0ASEX and $NPG, by buying whichever one it holds less of, in $1 steps. At most $4 a day and $40 in total. It can lose money: token prices can fall and listings can be thin. Two tokens is not diversification.
goals: Keep roughly equal dollar amounts of $B0ASEX and $NPG. Each time, buy $1 of the one this account holds less of (by value). Never sell.

spec.needs: Agent account with at least $10 of BSV
